units.text: 3) organizing the preparation of draft acts of the state body concerning entry into and performance of civil service, conclusion of a service contract, appointment to a civil service position, release from a civil service position, dismissal from civil service and retirement on a length-of-service pension, and formalizing the corresponding decisions of the state body;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 4) maintaining civil servants' employment record books (where available), compiling information on their employment activities during civil service and submitting that information, under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on individual (personalized) records in the compulsory pension insurance system, for storage in the information resources of the Pension and Social Insurance Fund of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 5) maintaining civil servants' personal files;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 6) maintaining the register of civil servants of the state body;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 7) preparing and issuing civil servants' official identity cards;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 8) supporting the activities of the commission for resolving conflicts of interest;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 9) organizing and supporting competitions to fill vacant civil service positions and to include civil servants and citizens in the personnel reserve;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 10) organizing and supporting the attestation of civil servants;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 11) repealed. — Federal Law No. 645-ФЗ of 29.12.2022;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 12) organizing the conclusion of targeted education agreements;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 13) organizing civil servants' professional development;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 14) forming the personnel reserve, organizing work with it and ensuring its effective use;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 15) supporting civil servants' career advancement;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 16) organizing and conducting checks of information submitted by a citizen upon entry into civil service and by a civil servant during service;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 16.1) processing clearance of the prescribed form for access to information constituting a state secret;
units.label: Point 16.1 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 17) organizing internal service inquiries;
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 18) organizing checks of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and of civil servants' compliance with the restrictions established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 19) advising civil servants on legal and other civil service matters.
units.label: Point 19 Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 2. The regulations on the state body's unit responsible for state service and personnel shall be approved by the head of the state body.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 44

units.text: 3. The state information systems provided for in Article 44.1 of this Federal Law shall be used in personnel work.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service
units.text: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service
units.label: Art. 44.1

units.locator: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service
units.text: 1. A federal state information system in the field of state service shall be used to provide information support for federal civil service and optimize the work of personnel services of federal state bodies and public authorities of a federal territory. The procedure for using the federal state information system in the field of state service shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 44.1

units.locator: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service
units.text: 2. Specific features of using the federal state information system in the field of state service in individual federal state bodies shall be determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 44.1

units.locator: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service
units.text: 3. To provide information support for the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation and optimize the work of personnel services of its state bodies, a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity shall provide for use of the federal state information system in the field of state service or for creation of a state information system in the field of civil service of the constituent entity. The latter system must be compatible with the federal state information system in the field of state service and meet unified requirements for the scope and content of information on staffing state bodies that is to be stored, processed and transmitted electronically. Those requirements shall be established by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 44.1

units.locator: Chapter 8. SERVICE TIME AND REST TIME
units.text: Chapter 8. SERVICE TIME AND REST TIME
units.label: Chapter 8. SERVICE TIME AND REST TIME

units.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time
units.text: Article 45. Service time and rest time
units.label: Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time
units.text: 1. Service time means the time during which a civil servant must perform official duties in accordance with the internal service rules of the state body, the service schedule or the terms of the service contract, as well as other periods classified as service time by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time
units.text: 2. The normal duration of service time for a civil servant may not exceed 40 hours per week. A five-day service week shall be established for civil servants.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time
units.text: 3. An irregular service day shall be established for civil servants holding positions in the highest and principal groups of civil service positions. For civil servants holding positions in other groups, an irregular service day shall be established in accordance with the internal service rules of the state body, the corresponding list of positions and the service contract.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time
units.text: 4. Civil servants subject to an irregular service day shall be granted additional annual paid leave for irregular service days in accordance with Article 46 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time
units.text: 5. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 176-ФЗ of 02.06.2016.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time
units.text: 6. The right to rest shall be exercised by providing civil servants with time free from official duties (free time) outside the normal duration of service time established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 45

units.text: Article 46. Leave in civil service
units.label: Art. 46

units.text: 1. A civil servant shall be granted annual leave with retention of the civil service position held and monetary remuneration.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 46

units.text: 2. A civil servant's annual paid leave shall consist of basic paid leave and additional paid leave.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 46

units.text: 3. Civil servants shall be granted basic annual paid leave of 30 calendar days.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 46

units.text: 4. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 176-ФЗ of 02.06.2016.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 46

units.text: 5. Civil servants shall be granted additional annual paid leave for length of service of the following duration:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 46

units.text: 1) for civil service length from 1 year to 5 years — 1 calendar day;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 46

units.text: 2) for civil service length from 5 to 10 years — 5 calendar days;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 46

units.text: 3) for civil service length from 10 to 15 years — 7 calendar days;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 46

units.text: 4) for civil service length of 15 years or more — 10 calendar days.
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 46

units.text: 6. In calculating the total duration of annual paid leave, basic annual paid leave shall be added to additional annual paid leave for length of service.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 46

units.text: Additional leave for irregular service days and for arduous, harmful and (or) hazardous civil service conditions shall be granted in addition to the annual paid leave provided for in this part.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 46 · “Additional leave for irregular service days and for arduous,…”

units.text: 6.1. Civil servants subject to an irregular service day shall be granted additional annual paid leave for irregular service days of three calendar days.
units.label: Part 6.1 Art. 46

units.text: 7. A civil servant shall be granted additional annual paid leave for arduous, harmful and (or) hazardous civil service conditions, including service in localities with special climatic conditions, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 46

units.text: 8. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 418-ФЗ of 30.12.2015.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 46

units.text: 9. Annual paid leave must be granted to a civil servant each year in accordance with the leave schedule approved by the employer's representative.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 46

units.text: 9.1. The minimum duration of annual paid leave taken by a civil servant in the service year for which it is granted may not be less than 28 calendar days. At least one portion of the annual paid leave must be at least 14 calendar days.
units.label: Part 9.1 Art. 46

units.text: 9.2. In exceptional cases, if granting a civil servant annual paid leave in the current service year for the total duration calculated in accordance with part 6 of this Article may adversely affect the performance of the state body's tasks and functions or the exercise of the powers of a person holding a state office, the portion of annual paid leave exceeding 28 calendar days may, by decision of the employer's representative and with the civil servant's written consent, be carried over to the next service year. The portion carried over must be taken no later than 12 months after the end of the service year for which that portion of leave is granted.
units.label: Part 9.2 Art. 46

units.text: 9.3. The portion of annual paid leave exceeding 28 calendar days, or any number of days from that portion, may be replaced by monetary compensation upon the civil servant's written application.
units.label: Part 9.3 Art. 46

units.text: 10. A civil servant's monetary remuneration for the period of annual paid leave must be paid no later than 10 calendar days before the leave begins.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 46

units.text: 11. When a federal civil servant is granted annual paid leave, a lump-sum payment equal to two monthly remuneration salaries shall be made once a year.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 46

units.text: 12. When a civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is granted annual paid leave, a lump-sum payment shall be made once a year in accordance with the legislation of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 46

units.text: 13. Upon termination or cancellation of a service contract, release from the civil service position held and dismissal from civil service, the civil servant shall be paid monetary compensation for all unused leave. Upon the civil servant's written application, unused leave may be granted followed by dismissal (except where release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service are due to culpable acts). In that case, the last day of leave shall be considered the date of release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 46

units.text: 14. In the event of dismissal due to expiry of the service contract, leave followed by dismissal may also be granted where the leave falls wholly or partly beyond the term of the service contract. In that case, the last day of leave shall likewise be considered the date of release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 46

units.text: 15. For family circumstances or other valid reasons, a civil servant may, upon their written application and by decision of the employer's representative, be granted leave without monetary remuneration for no more than one year. A civil servant shall also be granted leave without monetary remuneration in other cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 46

units.text: 16. During leave without monetary remuneration, the civil servant shall retain the civil service position held.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 46

units.text: Chapter 9. PERFORMANCE OF CIVIL SERVICE
units.label: Chapter 9. PERFORMANCE OF CIVIL SERVICE

units.text: Article 47. Official duties regulations
units.label: Art. 47

units.text: 1. A civil servant's professional service activities shall be carried out in accordance with official duties regulations approved by the employer's representative.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 47

units.text: 2. The official duties regulations shall include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 47

units.text: 1) qualification requirements for holding the civil service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 47

units.text: 2) official duties;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 47
